name: widebed-automation
description: Widebed Automation — self-hosted visual workflow automation platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:worker -w apps/api
